cycle_report.summary: Successfully consolidated the broken Email Investigation Service from scattered AtlasForge locations into a standalone deployment at /home/vader/Email_Investigations/. Fixed all 4 critical bugs: broken investigation pipeline (hardcoded mini-mind-v2 paths), daemon startup race conditions, non-functional Prometheus metrics, and stale systemd service paths. The service is now running, verified end-to-end with real email processing, PDF generation, and completion emails.
